definitions.gloss: expressive ability; power of expression; expressiveness
definitions.explanation: The ability to convey thoughts, feelings, or ideas effectively through language, art, music, dance, or other creative means.

examples.japanese: {表現力|ひょうげんりょく}が{豊|ゆた}かだ。
この{画家|がか}は{表現力|ひょうげんりょく}に{優|すぐ}れている。
examples.english: This painter excels in expressive ability.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもの{表現力|ひょうげんりょく}を{伸|の}ばすために{絵|え}を{描|か}かせている。
examples.english: I have the children draw pictures to develop their expressive ability.

notes:
Compound of {表現|ひょうげん} (expression) + {力|りょく} (power, ability). Refers to the capacity to express oneself effectively, whether through words, art, music, acting, or other media. Highly valued in Japanese education and artistic contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {表現力|ひょうげんりょく}が{豊|ゆた}か: rich in expressiveness
- {表現力|ひょうげんりょく}に{優|すぐ}れる: to excel in expression
- {表現力|ひょうげんりょく}を{磨|みが}く: to polish one's expressive skills
- {表現力|ひょうげんりょく}を{伸|の}ばす: to develop expressive ability
- {表現力|ひょうげんりょく}が{乏|とぼ}しい: lacking in expressiveness

RELATED TERMS:
- {表現|ひょうげん}: expression (the act or result)
- {想像力|そうぞうりょく}: imaginative power
- {語彙力|ごいりょく}: vocabulary ability
